about: The gold tier 3 CT dataset's page data, written by python3 tools/gold3_ct.py page; confidential.

checks.holds: the mask is readable, of an integer type, its shape and affine sane, on the rib mask's grid.
checks.title: header

checks.holds: vertebra ids 1 to 28 and rib ids 1 to 26 (the sternum counted apart), nothing outside the scheme.
checks.title: alphabet

checks.holds: C2 and the sacrum at LEVEL_MIN_VOXELS or more and every level from C2 to T12; a lumbar label missing other than L5 is whole by the owner's rule and a look; an absent L5 is excepted.
checks.title: whole rule

checks.holds: neighbouring labels in head-foot order; a lower label whose top lies above the upper's is a look.
checks.title: head-foot order

checks.holds: a space over UNLABELLED_GAP_MM above T12 fails (a body with no label); below T12, or over LOOK_GAP_MM anywhere, it is a look.
checks.title: gaps

checks.holds: C2 in the field's top slice, so its top may be cut off: a look.
checks.title: C2 in the field's top slice

checks.holds: an L5 label under FRAGMENT_SHARE of L4's voxels over an L4 that meets the sacrum.
checks.title: L5 fragment

checks.holds: the lowest lumbar label touches the sacrum in 3-D, so no body without a label lies between; and across a labelled L5, L4 stays as far from the sacrum as in every control.
checks.title: lowest lumbar label touches the sacrum

checks.holds: every rib with contacts leads on its own label, k + 7; more than SHIFT_SHARE of them one level off the same way is a shifted ladder and fails, fewer off is a look.
checks.title: rib ladder

checks.holds: each side's lowest rib meets its own vertebra; off its own fails, no contact or a tie is a look.
checks.title: lowest rib meets its own vertebra

checks.holds: a column label under SPLIT_SHARE of both neighbours' voxels is a piece split off a body.
checks.title: split piece

checks.holds: a column label whose largest connected piece holds under COMPONENT_SHARE of its voxels.
checks.title: fragments

checks.holds: C7's voxels over T1's outside the controls' 1st to 99th percentile.
checks.title: C7 against T1

checks.holds: an independent reading of the same masks (facts B) agrees on the inputs of Q08 to Q10.
checks.title: two implementations agree

checks.holds: the NIfTI's slice spacing no wider than the slice thickness CT-details.xlsx gives.
checks.title: slice spacing against the table

checks.holds: each mask's bytes are what the public bucket lists; a repaired vertebra mask is not listed.
checks.title: bucket bytes
